KMSDataEncryption.description_en:
Specifies the encryption algorithm for the object. If this parameter is not specified, the object is encrypted by using the AES256 encryption algorithm. This parameter is valid only when SSEAlgorithm is set to KMS.
Valid values: SM4

SSEAlgorithm.description_en:
Sets the default server-side encryption method.
Valid values: KMS, AES256, SM4
Using the KMS key feature incurs a small amount of KMS key API call fees. For more information about fees, see **[KMS billing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52608.html）**.
When performing cross-region replication (CRR), if the destination bucket has default server-side encryption enabled and the replication rule is configured with ReplicaCMKID, the following two cases apply:
If objects in the source bucket are not encrypted, the default encryption method of the destination bucket is used to encrypt the plaintext objects replicated from the source bucket.
If objects in the source bucket are encrypted by using SSE-KMS or SSE-OSS, the destination bucket continues to use the original encryption method for these objects.

For more information, see **[CRR combined with server-side encryption]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/177216.html）**
SSEAlgorithm.description_zh:
设置服务器端默认加密方式。
取值：KMS、AES256、SM4
使用KMS密钥功能时会产生少量的KMS密钥API调用费用，费用详情请参见**[KMS计费标准]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/52608.html）**。
进行跨区域复制时，若目标Bucket启用了默认服务器端加密方式，且复制规则配置了ReplicaCMKID，有以下两种情况：
若源Bucket中的对象未加密，则使用目标Bucket的默认加密方式对跨区域复制过来的明文对象进行加密。
若源Bucket中的对象使用了SSE-KMS或SSE-OSS的加密方式，则目标Bucket针对这些对象仍然使用原加密方式进行加密。

更多信息，请参见**[跨区域复制结合服务器端加密]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/177216.html）**
